content_sections.heading: About the Vidyalaya
content_sections.text: PM Shri School Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya, Sili, Silvassa is a school at Gaon Sili, Tehsil Silvassa, Dadra and Nagar Haveli 396230. Its letterhead places it under the Ministry of Education, Govt. of India, Department of School Education & Literacy. The notice is signed by Manoj Kumar Joshi, Principal I/C, JNV Silvassa. The posts are for the Vidyalaya itself, for the year 2026-27.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice lists 11 vacancies across 11 posts. The table below gives each post's vacancies, a short qualification and pay. The full qualification for each post follows the table. Post Graduation in Concerned Subject with at least 50% Marks with B.Ed at least 50% Marks. The pay is 35750/-P.M. Bachelor's Degree studied in English as elective / main subject with at least 50% marks. B.Ed Degree with at least 50% marks. Qualified in Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET) Paper II conducted by CBSE. Studied any two subjects out of History, Geography, Economics and Political Science during graduation. One of these must be either History or Geography, in at least 3 years / 6 semesters, with at least 50% marks. B.Ed Degree with at least 50% marks. Qualified in Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET) Paper II conducted by CBSE. Bachelor's Degree studied in Hindi as elective / main subject with at least 50% marks. B.Ed Degree with at least 50% marks. Qualified in Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET) Paper II conducted by CBSE. BE / B.Tech in Computer Science / IT / Bachelor's Degree BCA with at least 50% marks. B.Ed Degree with at least 50% marks. Qualified in Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET) Paper II conducted by CBSE. There is one post for a male and one for a female Hostel Superintendent. The notice prints these conditions for the post: Graduation in any discipline. Desirable: Masters Degree / B.Ed. Age between 35 to 60 years. Minimum 02 years experience in pay level 3 (Rs.21700) or above of 7th CPC (or equivalent scale) in any recognized school. Ex-defence personnel having experience of minimum 02 years in Pay Level-3 or above of 7th CPC. The notice prints this post as "LAB ATTEND". The qualification is Class XII Passed in Science Stream. The pay is 650 per day plus PF. Minimum Class X Passed. Age between 35 to 55 years. Married females, which include widows or divorcees without encumbrance. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post. The notice does not give an age limit for the PGT, TGT and Lab Attendant posts, and it prints no date for counting age and no age relaxation. The pay of the teaching posts and the Hostel Superintendent is a fixed monthly amount. The Lab Attendant and the Matron are paid per day, and only the Lab Attendant's pay mentions PF. The notice names no other allowance.

faq.question: Q1. When is the JNV Silvassa walk-in interview 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 23 November 2026 at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. Where will the JNV Silvassa walk-in interview be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at PM Shri School Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya, Sili, Silvassa, U.T. of Dadra & Nagar Haveli - 396230.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there in JNV Silvassa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 11 vacancies. These are 3 PGT posts, 4 TGT posts, 2 Hostel Superintendent posts (1 male, 1 female), 1 Lab Attendant and 1 Matron.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for PGT posts at JNV Silvassa?
faq.answer: PGT Physics, Maths and Chemistry need Post Graduation in the concerned subject with at least 50% marks, with B.Ed at least 50% marks.

faq.question: Q5. Is CTET required for the TGT posts?
faq.answer: Yes. TGT English, Social Science, Hindi and Computer Science all require qualifying CTET Paper II conducted by CBSE, along with the degree and B.Ed with at least 50% marks.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for Hostel Superintendent and Matron?
faq.answer: The Hostel Superintendent must be between 35 to 60 years. The Matron must be between 35 to 55 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for JNV Silvassa contract posts?
faq.answer: PGT and Hostel Superintendent get 35750/-P.M. and TGT gets 34125/-P.M. The Lab Attendant gets 650 per day + PF, and the Matron gets 556 per day.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring original documents, one set of Xerox copies, passport size photos, Aadhar card / PAN card and a bank passbook copy.

faq.question: Q9. Are these permanent posts?
faq.answer: No. The posts are filled purely on contract basis for the year 2026-27.

faq.question: Q10. Who can apply for the Matron post at JNV Silvassa?
faq.answer: Married females, including widows or divorcees without encumbrance, can apply. They must have passed at least Class X and be between 35 to 55 years.
